brief:
Israel named Joel Lion as its new envoy to Turkey, with the diplomat presenting his credentials in Ankara this week, Middle East Eye reported. The appointment proceeds even as Israel's embassy in the Turkish capital remains effectively closed due to security concerns that have disrupted normal diplomatic operations.

The envoy's posting represents an attempt to maintain formal representation in Turkey despite the practical constraints facing the mission. Israeli-Turkish relations have grown strained over Israel's military operations in Gaza and the shifting situation in Syria, complicating bilateral ties between the two countries that have historically served as regional powers with competing interests.

title: Israel appoints new envoy to Turkey despite Gaza tensions
